title: Duration units are seconds
rationale: The EVM folder documents s=1, m=60, h=3600, d=86400, w=604800. Solidity does not apply that table. Empty-return token policy is separate.
note: SPEC_GAP for Solidity lowering of now and Duration. The independent table is checked by the property test. EVM lowering is blocked by KF-EVM-UNKNOWN-SHR and inverted by KF-EVM-CMP-ORDER.
logos_source:
Contract C
State
  record { start_ts : Int = 1700000000 }
Clauses
  Clause Release(): Effect
    Provided That
      now >= start_ts + Duration("7d")
    Shall
      Set { field: "start_ts", value: 1 }
End
